Job description

#VEMSERCAEDU

Procuramos profissionais que sejam #SoluçãoParaoCliente , #ConfiemColaboremCompartilhem e que tenham #AlegriaEnergiaeAcolhimento !

Atuamos no varejo de moda há 50 anos e estamos presentes nos estados de São Paulo, Rio Grande do Sul, Goiás, DF e Minas Gerais com 100 lojas .

Temos um ambiente alegre e acolhedor e o melhor de tudo, com possibilidade de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional!

Se você busca desafios em sua área de atuação, não abre mão de ética e respeito , tem senso de dono e acredita que juntos somos mais fortes , vem para Caedu .

Na Caedu nós trabalhamos com um propósito claro: Compartilhar o que temos de melhor para vestir histórias mais felizes. Para isso, respeitamos a diversidade, trabalhamos com senso de dono e queremos proporcionar o melhor para os nossos colaboradores e cliente SEMPRE!

Main responsibilities

Quais serão suas atividades?

  1. Definir as Políticas de Crédito e Cobrança dos produtos Cartão Caedu e Empréstimo Pessoal.
  2. Monitorar e divulgar os principais indicadores de inadimplência da carteira (safras), semanalmente para o Head da Operação, visando realizar alterações imediatas nos modelos de crédito para evitar aumento no risco de inadimplência.
  3. Assegurar disseminação e conhecimento dos relatórios diários e mensais divulgados através das ferramentas de comunicação interna da companhia e avaliar continuamente os processos de concessão na ponta, visando sempre redução de tempo ao cliente na loja e ganho de produtividade.
  4. Implementar políticas de crédito e cobrança, campeã e desafiante baseado no uso intensivo de dados de mercado para melhorar as politicas de crédito e cobrança.
  5. Definir em conjunto com o time de risco e Head as políticas e alçadas para aprovação de crédito.
  6. Desenvolver metodologias e instrumentos para avaliação e atribuição de limites de crédito a serem obedecidos nas operações do Cartão CAEDU.
  7. Avaliar se o crédito foi concedido dentro da Política de Crédito estabelecida pelos modelos de gestão de risco.
  8. Acompanhar a carteira de crédito quanto a sua performance.
  9. Revisar e aprovar os relatórios de acompanhamento de créditos e de performance da carteira.
  10. Definir e executar as políticas e régua de cobrança eletrônica, amigável e contenciosa interagindo com a processadora na definição de bloqueio e cancelamento do cartão.
  11. Definir campanhas de renegociação de dívida junto às Assessorias de Cobrança.
  12. Responder pela correta aplicação dos procedimentos estabelecidos nas políticas de Crédito e Cobrança da Caedu.
  13. Gerenciar as ações de cobrança externa, definindo estratégias para recuperação do crédito Cobrança.
  14. Analisar os créditos em atraso seguindo a política estabelecida.
  15. Monitorar mensalmente a performance de todos os modelos estatísticos de gerenciamento de risco das operações da Caedu.
  16. Constituir provisões para clientes individuais de acordo com a política da Caedu.
  17. Monitorar rentabilidade baseado nos modelos estatísticos de gerenciamento de risco e propor alterações de pricing das operações.

Requirements and skills

Com certeza tem que ter:

  • Superior Completo em Matemática, Engenharia, Estatística, Ciência da Computação, Economia, Administração de Empresas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em área de negócios ou afins.
  • Pacote office avançado, Excel avançado, Power Point Avançado
  • Conhecimentos e vivência em desenvolvimento de modelos estatísticos.
  • Conhecimento em linguagem de programação SQL, SPSS e afins.

It may entail correcting, removing, adding, and formatting portions of content to make the source content ready for translation and the translated content meaningful prior to delivery to local customers.

He/she works effectively with other members of the IQVIA Translation Services team as well as with external resources to deliver high-standard services. The Content Design Specialist may also coordinate efforts from several Content Design Specialists when needed to meet project requirements.

He/she enjoys working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment and is a strong team player who always remains result-oriented. • Analyse and eliminate all correctness and usability issues to meet quality requirements and deadlines

• Act as a link between Project Managers, reviewers and post-editors as necessary to solve issues quickly and effectively

• Ensure that identified issues are defined and described clearly to inform assigned Project Managers and linguists and increase their level of performance and engagement

• Mentor and help Content Design Specialists as needed and coordinate their efforts to make projects time and cost effective

• Experience as a translator, a linguist and/or a DTP specialist is a strong asset, yet not a must

• Experience in project management is a strong asset

• Proven experience working with projects involving large amounts of content is desirable

• Knowledge of software QA, QC, DTP and/or OCR methodologies, tools, and processes is beneficial

• Experience mentoring people and coordinating team efforts is beneficial

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to work independently and proactively, as part of a team and with diverse teams.

MINIMUM REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE :

description:
Join to apply for the General Project Engineering (Project Design Team Lead) - Santa Barbara d'Oeste - SP role at Siemens Energy .

A Snapshot of Your Day

The role of Project Design Team Lead is to schedule and coordinate the scope of assigned projects that flow through the product design team. This position does not have direct reports but will lead various teams assigned per project requirements, including the coordination of daily activities.

Excellent collaboration and communication are critical to this role. This position offers growth opportunities beyond the core responsibilities, including interaction with the global Siemens-Energy TCP Organization and potential role expansion.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Coordinate and participate in key meetings (kickoff, weekly status, scheduling) and workflows (SAP, Globus), driving process improvements and maintaining effective communication across all cross-functional teams.
  • Provide work coordination and assignments with permanent and contract detailers, as required.
  • Act as a first point of contact for technical issues, managing team expectations, and serving as a positive role model, with a focus on reviewing proposals to capture scope accurately and maintaining project hours.
  • Provide training and guidance to less experienced design team members, assist manufacturing, purchasing, and planning with drawing and materials list interpretations, and address shop issues related to drawings as needed.
  • Engage in the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of design tools, product standards, and standards for turbomachinery products, potentially assisting with interviewing and onboarding new team members.
  • Support the product line's success through collaboration with the solution development team on commercial offerings and perform miscellaneous duties as required.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent with experience in rotating machinery, or an Associate Degree in drafting with design drafting and industry experience. More experienced candidates may qualify for a senior position.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, ability to see the broader picture, and outstanding communication skills for effective collaboration.
  • Ability to independently manage complex projects with enthusiasm and focus, whether working alone or in a team.
  • Professionalism and tact in interactions at all levels, along with strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, advanced 2D/3D CAD, and familiarity with ERP systems like SAP or Oracle.
  • Flexibility and readiness for domestic and international travel (~5-15%).

About The Team

Our Transformation of Industry division focuses on decarbonizing the industrial sector through increased electrification and efficiency, supporting the transition to sustainable processes with a global presence and diverse technologies.

With ~100,000 employees worldwide, Siemens Energy develops future energy systems, ensuring reliable and sustainable energy supply, driving the energy transition, and fostering innovation rooted in a 150-year legacy.

description:
Join an industry leader and make a positive change in the sustainable use of the world’s natural resources. Together, we will transform the business and drive the industry toward a greener future.

At Metso, you will be supported by our inclusive culture and a network of colleagues from around the world. With us, you will embark on a personal growth journey and are encouraged to realize your potential. This is your invitation to rise above the possible.

Job posting end date: 06/01/2025

Introdução

Estamos buscando por Coordenador(a) de Engenharia Industrial para se juntar à nossa equipe de CNS SC Assembly & Fabrication em Sorocaba. Você será responsável por coordenar as atividades da engenharia industrial e do time da qualidade para equipamentos vibratórios, seguindo os padrões estabelecidos pela empresa referente à custos, prazos, qualidade, segurança, motivação/comprometimento dos colaboradores, 5 “S” e zelo dos recursos e equipamentos fabris. Desempenhará um papel crucial para o sucesso do nosso negócio.
Nesta posição, você se reportará ao Gerente Industrial.
Esta posição está localizada principalmente em Sorocaba e envolve até 15% de viagens.

Equipe a qual você pertence

Você se juntará a uma equipe de Assembly & Fabrication de Screening dedicada à fabricação e montagem de componentes e equipamentos vibratórios para a linha de mineração e construção.
Trabalhamos em estreita colaboração com partes interessadas internas/externas, como engenharia do produto, coordenação de contratos, planejamento e outras áreas relacionadas com a área de Consumables (CNS).
A cultura da nossa equipe gira em torno de cliente no centro, grande ambição - sempre, fazendo o que deve ser feito – juntos e abertos e sinceros.
Os membros da nossa equipe estão localizados em Sorocaba - SP

O que você fará

  1. Coordenar as operações da área da Engenharia Industrial, alinhando-as com as metas e estratégias definidas.
  2. Coordenar as atividades da equipe da qualidade nas definições de roteiros de inspeção, ações corretivas e controle da qualidade.
  3. Coordenar projetos/implementação de expansão das áreas de manufatura.
  4. Administrar/Coordenar os recursos da equipe, assegurando que suas habilidades atendam às demandas específicas da função e incentivando seu desenvolvimento contínuo.
  5. Coordenar projetos de melhorias visando a excelência operacional.
  6. Coordenar as atividades de abertura, controle e implementação dos investimentos da fábrica.

Quem é você

Graduação completa em engenharia mecânica, elétrica, produção, eletromecânica, tecnologia ou áreas afins;
Experiência profissional em gestão de pessoas, com desenvolvimento de estratégia, gestão de talentos e gestão de desempenho.
Mandatório experiência em conceitos e procedimentos de processos de fabricação (mecânica e soldagem), com implementação e execução.
Experiência com projetos de expansão fabril será um diferencial.
Conhecimento da metodologia Lean/Six Sigma - desejável.
Inglês avançado – mandatório.
Pacote Office avançado.

O que oferecemos

  • Um propósito inspirador – Possibilitar uma vida moderna sustentável. Minerais e metais são a espinha dorsal de funções essenciais no mundo moderno. No entanto, há uma necessidade de soluções mais sustentáveis para coletá-los e processá-los. Na Metso, você participa da transformação da indústria e de uma mudança positiva.
  • Ambiente de trabalho seguro – Para a Metso, segurança é um valor fundamental. Nosso objetivo é demonstrar liderança e visão na promoção da cultura de segurança.
  • Bem-estar – Nossos serviços de saúde ocupacional, associados às ações voltadas para a promoção de saúde e bem-estar, demonstram nossa preocupação com a qualidade de vida e engajamento das pessoas.
  • Remuneração e benefícios – Estrutura de remuneração e benefícios alinhada às práticas de mercado, oferecendo um pacote atrativo através de uma composição equilibrada que contém remuneração fixa e variável, além de assistência médica, odontológica, seguro de vida, previdência privada, alimentação, entre outros, segundo políticas vigentes.
  • Flexibilidade – Valorizamos interações presenciais e um ambiente de trabalho aberto e flexível, promovendo equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional.
  • Uma cultura próspera – Estamos empenhados em desenvolver uma cultura inclusiva que permita a todos dar o seu melhor e atingir seu potencial. Uma cultura corajosa, convincente, atenciosa, que nos une para construir um futuro sustentável.
  • Extensas oportunidades de aprendizagem – Estimulamos diálogos contínuos, feedbacks, mobilidade interna, mentoria, treinamentos e desenvolvimento, além de projetos globais.
  • Interação sem fronteiras – Aproveite nossa rede global de colegas para troca de experiências e conhecimentos, com comunicação aberta e sincera.

Contato

Quer superar os limites conosco? Clique em “Inscrever-se” agora.
Para informações adicionais, entre em contato com a área de RH - Recrutamento & Seleção.

How to join - Working at Metso - About Metso - Diversity and Inclusion - Meet our people

Metso é um empregador que promove igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido com uma cultura inclusiva e diversa. Todos os candidatos qualificados receberão consideração para emprego sem distinção de raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, condição de veterano protegido ou deficiência.

A Metso é líder em tecnologias sustentáveis, soluções completas e serviços para as indústrias de agregados, processamento de minerais e refino de metais globalmente. Melhoramos a eficiência de energia e água de nossos clientes, aumentamos sua produtividade e reduzimos riscos ambientais com nossa expertise em produtos e serviços. Somos o parceiro para mudanças positivas.

Responsibilities
Team Introduction
The AMS global accounting team is part of the Accounting and Reporting team. Our team covers the general accounting functions in the US, Canada, and LATAM. Position Summary
The LATAM Accounting Manager is responsible for overseeing the financial reporting, compliance, and accounting operations across multiple countries in the LATAM region (Brazil, Colombia, Argentina and Mexico). This role ensures adherence to local and international accounting standards, tax regulations, and corporate financial policies while driving process improvements and efficiency in financial operations.
We are seeking a highly driven Accounting Manager who can move fast and learn quickly to help establish new processes, improve and scale existing processes for our LATAM Infrastructure portfolio, including Brazil, Colombia, Argentina and Mexico operations.
The ideal candidate has previous experience developing and refining business processes. They should possess a deep understanding of various business models and be able to analyze existing processes to identify areas for improvement. This candidate has a proven track record of successfully implementing process enhancements that have led to increased efficiency, reduced costs, and improved overall business performance.
With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our Accounting team. Together we can build an e-commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure, and intuitive for our users.
You should be able to work well with cross-border colleagues and cross-functional teams and assist with the management and ownership of the end-to-end operational processes for the subject areas. The successful candidate will be a highly driven, focused individual who can work well with internal and external partners at all levels.

Responsibilities
-Research accounting implications (in collaboration with Bytedance’s accounting headquarter team in Hong Kong) from changes in the business, stay up-to-date on changes in industry trends, and use the information to inform internal decisions.

-Partner with the local accounting firms to finish local monthly bookkeeping operations.
-Coordinate with external and internal auditors to ensure timely completion of audit requests, and aid in the research and analysis of audit issues raised.
-Basic knowledge of local tax rules and accounting implications.

Also, able to translate/apply GAAP/international policies to operationalise complex accounting issues, including assessing the design and/or effectiveness of internal controls.
-Stay up-to-date with relevant accounting standards, and assess operational implications for any relevant changes.

-Minimum 5 years of experience in accounting fields.

-Local filing experience and CRC certification.
-Great communication skills & proficiency in English.
-Experience working with business partners and engineers to effect changes.
-Experience in optimizing or re-designing existing processes resulting from business needs.
Preferred Qualifications:
-Familiarity with local GAAP and IFRS.
-Experience working with LATAM countries, familiar with LATAM accounting policies.
-Experience with Oracle.
-System implementation experience.
-Applicable in-house TMT industry experience.

ByteDance is a global incubator of platforms at the cutting edge of commerce, content, entertainment, and enterprise services - over 2.5 billion people interact with ByteDance products, including TikTok.

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Nossopropósitoétransformar o futuro de cidades e pessoas, e pode ser o seu também!

Somos uma GovTech pioneira no desenvolvimento de sistemas inteligentes em nuvem para gestão pública no Brasil, focados na construção de cidades inteligentes. Fomos os primeiros da América Latina a desenvolver sistemas de gestão em cloud computing, considerando empresas públicas e privadas. Aqui, valorizamos a inovação, colaboração, sentimento de dono, foco no cliente, atitude descomplicada e ágil, e a mão-na-massa. description:
A Prosegur passou por um importante processo de expansão internacional, o que levou a empresa ao posto de referência global do setor de segurança privada. Por meio de suas diferentes linhas de negócios, a companhia oferece às empresas e lugares uma segurança de confiança, baseada nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado.

VIGILANTE PATRIMONIAL INTERMITENTE - JOÃO PESSOA - PB

Faça parte do time de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo!

Nosso propósito é Tornar o Mundo um Lugar Mais Seguro e não vamos parar até conseguir, pois somos incansáveis e pensamos positivamente.

Nossa paixão? Cuidar de todos, sejam eles clientes, o planeta ou nossos colaboradores, pois as pessoas são importantes para nós.

Trabalhamos para que as pessoas vivam tranquilamente, tanto em seu ambiente físico quanto no digital, a fim de gerar um impacto positivo em sua vida pessoal e profissional.

Com mais de 40 anos de história, presente em 31 países e com mais de 160.000 funcionários em todo o mundo. Somos uma das empresas líderes mundiais do setor de Segurança Privada, que oferece Soluções Integradas de Segurança, adaptadas às necessidades de nossos clientes.

Toda nossa história não seria possível sem um time de heróis e por isso desenvolvemos diariamente programas específicos para atrair novos talentos e promovemos a carreira dos nossos profissionais com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades internas de crescimento.

Trabalhamos todos os dias para oferecer segurança inovadora com base nas soluções mais avançadas do mercado. No Brasil, o Grupo Prosegur conta com três linhas de negócio: Segurpro, Prosegur Cash e Cipher. Viva uma excelente experiência, participando de um processo seletivo 100% digital, pois temos equipes dedicadas para garantir a qualidade, segurança e humanização em todas as etapas!

Diversidade & Inclusão na Prosegur

Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho!

O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. Acreditamos que times diversos podem garantir resultados espetaculares além de impulsionar nossa cultura inovadora.

Conheça esta oportunidade de trabalho na Segurpro e se você possui os requisitos para a vaga, FAÇA JÁ A SUA INSCRIÇÃO.

* Vaga aberta a pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Se você é PCD e possui os requisitos e interesse, junte-se à nossa equipe de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo e venha ser Protagonista de uma história de sucesso!

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Visualizar a área, garantindo a segurança do local, mantendo a atenção quanto à movimentação de pessoas e veículos.
  • Efetuar ações preventivas para manter a segurança do posto.
  • Manter postura firme, porém cortês em relação aos clientes e seus funcionários.
  • Fornecer todo tipo de informação e auxílio solicitada por seu superior imediato.
  • Atuar ostensivamente de forma a promover a segurança das pessoas, instalações e materiais, inibindo e coibindo ações prejudiciais aos interesses do cliente, sejam criminosas ou não, obedecendo às prescrições legais.
  • Cumprir as determinações e procedimentos estabelecidos para seu posto de serviço.
  • Elaborar relatórios diários de seu turno/posto de trabalho conforme estabelecidos pela empresa.
  • Responsabilizar-se pela custódia do material a seu cargo (armas, documentação e material do posto).
  • Preencher documentos necessários para o desempenho de sua função (livro de guarda e cartão ponto, por exemplo).
  • Em caso de sinistro, atuar proativamente de acordo com os procedimentos, preservando a própria vida e o patrimônio pelo qual está responsável.
  • Demais atividades inerentes à função.

REQUISITOS IMPRESCINDÍVEIS PARA SUA INSCRIÇÃO:

  • Ensino Médio completo ou em curso.
  • Curso de Formação de vigilante atualizado.
  • Conhecimento em informática.
  • Disponibilidade de horário.

- Executar casos de teste, depurar, detectar erros e/ou possíveis melhorias, documentá-los e acompanhá-los para serem resolvidos.
- Gerar relatórios de resultados de testes e erros detectados.
- Definir prioridades e planejar testes dos requisitos do sistema.
- Documentar as funcionalidades dos sistemas.
- Representar o usuário final junto aos desenvolvedores para garantir que os requisitos sejam atendidos.
- Detectar e propor melhorias tanto no processo de controle de qualidade quanto no ciclo de desenvolvimento de software.

Eis o que estamos procurando:

- 5+ anos de experiência em testes de produtos Web.
- Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL.
- Experiência com Microservices e a Nuvem.
- Conhecimento avançado de algoritmos.
- Conhecimento de infra-estrutura de TI.
- Gerenciamento de metodologias ágeis.
- Forte compreensão das melhores práticas, princípios SOLIDOS, Código CLEAN e soluções escaláveis.
- Conhecimento de Padrões de Design.
- Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações inteiras a partir do zero.
- Experiência em testes automatizados, dutos CI/CD.
- Forte experiência com controle de versão.
- Forte experiência com testes unitários, testes de integração e cobertura de código.
- Nível avançado de inglês.

Como tornamos seu trabalho (e sua vida) mais fácil:

  • Modalidade 100% remota - trabalhe de qualquer lugar.
  • Excelente remuneração em USD ou na sua moeda local, como preferir.
  • Hardware para você trabalhar de casa.

description:
Manychat is a leading Chat Marketing platform. We help businesses engage with their customers on Instagram, Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, and Telegram.

Manychat is a Meta Official Business Partner, backed by top investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners.

With 200+ teammates across three global offices — Barcelona, Yerevan, New York, Austin, and Amsterdam — Manychat helps more than one million businesses worldwide interact with billions of customers in real-time at scale.

No matter the use case — generating leads, increasing engagement, providing 24/7 customer support, accepting payments, and beyond — Manychat helps businesses improve their ROI and grow faster.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking a passionate Senior Business Analyst to manage and lead company-level analytics initiatives in Brazil.

The Senior Business Analyst will join the analytics team and report to the Head of Analytics, with a dotted line to the Brazil General Manager. The new team member will directly impact the direction of Manychat's further growth in Brazil by helping to form the mid and long-term country roadmap.

The ideal candidate is capable of conducting quantitative research, generating and validating product and market hypotheses, bringing relevant insights, and proposing solutions to proactively drive the market towards achieving our business goals.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Our analytics team has three foundational purposes:

  • Impact directly on business metrics.
  • Be proactive.

As part of the analytics team, you will:

  • Investigate the product from different angles, consolidating insights into a clear and cohesive action plan.
  • Manage and lead Monetization initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain Manychat's operational/growth model.
  • Build tools to monitor the company’s performance and help make quick and effective data-driven decisions.
  • Manage data and analytics projects with external parties (segmentation, forecasting, and data labeling) to find and validate promising product hypotheses.
  • Collaborate closely with the Leadership Team to identify and resolve product and business growth bottlenecks.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Must haves:

  • 5+ years of proven product/data/business analytics experience.
  • Technical background and knowledge of mathematical statistics.
  • Excellent technical skills (SQL, Python, BI tools).
  • Extreme attention to detail and strong work ethic.
  • Accountability and the permanent ‘extra mile’ approach to any task.
  • Readiness to take responsibility and obtain high-quality analytical deliverables in reasonable terms.
  • High level of proficiency in written and spoken English. (To be considered for this position, you must submit your resume in English)

Nice to haves:

  • Consulting (Big-4) background.
  • Previous experience in a fast-paced startup environment.

WHAT WE OFFER

We care about your growth, well-being, and comfort

  • Professional development budget for relevant conference tickets, training programs, or courses.
  • Flexible benefits plan to choose the perks that fit your needs.
  • Generous time-off policy to balance your work and life.

Manychat is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.

title: Ação policial em Alagoinhas apreende veículo clonado e prende suspeito armado
description:
Ação policial em Alagoinhas apreende veículo clonado e prende suspeito armado

Policiais do 4° BPM, em operação conjunta com o CICOM, prendem suspeito em flagrante com drogas e arma de fogo

Por: Redação

Compartilhe:

Foto: Divulgação/Quarto Batalhão

Na noite deste sábado (28), policiais do 4° Batalhão de Polícia Militar (BPM), durante a execução da Operação Falcão, foram acionados pelo Centro Integrado de Comunicações (CICOM) para verificar a denúncia de um veículo clonado identificado por câmeras de monitoramento na cidade de Alagoinhas. A guarnição iniciou buscas para localizar o Volkswagen Fox de cor preta, e, após algumas rondas, localizou o veículo na praça do Condomínio Linha Verde.

Durante a abordagem, a polícia realizou uma busca pessoal no condutor e também no veículo, encontrando diversos materiais ilícitos. Foram apreendidos um revólver calibre .28 com seis munições, uma porção de substância análoga à cocaína, três trouxinhas de substância análoga à maconha, além de uma ferramenta geralmente utilizada em arrombamentos de veículos.

Suspeito preso em flagrante é apresentado à Delegacia Territorial de Alagoinhas

Diante das evidências, o suspeito foi detido e, juntamente com o material apreendido e o veículo de placa clonada, conduzido à Delegacia Territorial de Alagoinhas. No local, foi lavrado o Auto de Prisão em Flagrante Delito, reforçando o sucesso da operação em combater o crime na região.

A operação segue como parte dos esforços contínuos da Polícia Militar da Bahia para garantir a segurança e a tranquilidade da população de Alagoinhas, intensificando o monitoramento e a repressão ao crime organizado.

* O conteúdo de cada comentário é de responsabilidade de quem realizá-lo. Nos reservamos ao direito de reprovar ou eliminar comentários em desacordo com o propósito do site ou que contenham palavras ofensivas. 500 caracteres restantes. Comentar

Alagoinhas é um município brasileiro do estado da Bahia, localizado no Agreste deste estado. Sua área é de 718,089 quilômetros quadrados e sua população em 2020 era de 152 327 habitantes, tendo portanto uma densidade demográfica de 210,05 habitantes por quilômetro quadrado

MERITOCRACIA - Para criar uma cultura justa, com transparência e feedback construtivo, é essencial reconhecer e recompensar o desempenho individual. Isso incentiva o aprendizado contínuo, a excelência e as conquistas, promovendo um ambiente onde o mérito é alcançado de forma justa.

RESPEITO E DIVERSÃO - Valorizamos um ambiente onde a autenticidade é celebrada e a flexibilidade é essencial, pois grandes resultados surgem de momentos de diversão e interações respeitosas. Isso aumenta a produtividade e fortalece nossa colaboração como uma equipa única, baseada no respeito mútuo e em momentos de descontração.

Responsabilidades:

  • Liderança e Gestão de Equipe: Supervisionar e motivar a equipe de Sucesso do Cliente, estabelecendo metas claras e fornecendo feedback contínuo para o desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Engajamento do Cliente: Desenvolver e implementar estratégias para aumentar o engajamento e a satisfação dos membros, garantindo que eles aproveitem plenamente os benefícios de sua associação.
  • Gestão de Relacionamento com o Cliente: Cultivar relações fortes com os membros, atuando como o ponto de contato principal e assegurando que suas necessidades sejam atendidas de forma eficaz e rápida.
  • Integração de Clientes: Coordenar e executar um processo de integração eficiente e acolhedor para novos membros, garantindo que compreendam e utilizem todas as ferramentas e recursos disponíveis.
  • Análise de Dados e Relatórios: Monitorar e analisar métricas de sucesso do cliente para identificar tendências, oportunidades de melhoria e reportar os resultados para a liderança sênior.
  • Inovação e Melhoria Contínua: Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências de mercado e melhores práticas em Sucesso do Cliente para implementar inovações que melhorem a experiência dos membros.
  • Colaboração Interdepartamental: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipas de Vendas, Marketing e Produto para alinhar estratégias de engajamento e garantir uma experiência coesa para os membros.

description:

Join to apply for the Channel Marketing Director role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We have created a new leadership role, Channel Marketing Director, to drive our Go-To-Market strategy across our partner ecosystem, from silicon to public cloud, through channel and hardware manufacturers. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we play a unique role in a variety of innovative value chains (Public Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI, IoT) supporting our partners both technically and commercially.
Reporting to the VP of Marketing you will lead a team of marketing managers running partner programs. You will work closely with our partners to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver open source based products and solutions. In this role you will ultimately be responsible for maximising the overall ROI of our campaigns supporting our partners motions whether sell-to, sell-through or sell-with.
The partner marketing team is formed of multi-talented marketing professionals, as comfortable formulating joint value propositions as they are about running lead generation campaigns. They have an eye for creating remarkable messages/assets and a hand in the selection of the most effective channels through a complex supply chain. They are passionate about technology, the users of enterprise technology, and are early adopters of advanced partner analytics technologies.
Location: This role is home based in the AMER region.
The role entails

  • Building a marketing strategy that drives pipeline growth and revenue outcomes through key partners – Silicon, IHV, ODM, Channel, GSIs, etc.
  • Aligning with growth, field and product marketing to deliver activities integrated with Canonical's campaigns.
  • Owning the execution of partner campaigns across the funnel from recruitment to demand generation programs.
  • Engaging and elevating the partner community through exceptional content in partnership with the communication, product and alliances teams.
  • Multiplying our partners' impact through programmatic approaches.
  • Crafting bespoke plans and joint value propositions to stand out in the marketplace.
  • Championing our partner collaboration vision both internally and externally.
  • Managing the use of Marketing Development Funds (MDF) whether we receive it or distribute it.
  • Driving the adoption of advanced analytics and reporting tools to continually improve the ROI of partner marketing activities.
  • Mentoring and developing a diverse team of partner marketers covering our whole spectrum of partners.
  • Cultivating a culture of continuous testing and optimization.
What we are looking for in you
  • Strong understanding of the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channels is essential for this role.
  • Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse partners around Go To Market strategies.
  • Proven track record of developing and executing successful co-marketing programs in the technology space.
  • Experience reporting on complex partner marketing activities and touchpoints.
  • Ability to create a culture of excellence, agility and self-drive in your team.
  • Curiosity with a habit of continuous learning.
  • Outstanding communications skills in English, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional academic results both at high school and university.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.
What we are looking for in you
  • Familiarity with a particular vertical (e.g. Telco, Finance, Industrial, Automotive).
  • Experience in leading distributed teams across different time zones.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

O seu impacto

Responsabilidades:

  • Planejar: Definir os objetivos, escopo, cronograma e orçamento do projeto.
  • Coordenar: Gerencia a equipe, os recursos e os fornecedores, garantindo a comunicação e a colaboração.
  • Controlar: Monitorar o progresso do projeto, identificando e resolvendo problemas, e implementando ações corretivas.
  • Gerenciamento de riscos: Avaliar e mitigar os riscos que podem afetar o projeto.
  • Análise de processos: Avaliar e aprimorar os processos de projeto para melhorar a eficiência e a qualidade.
  • Gestão de stakeholders: Interagir com clientes, patrocinadores e outras partes interessadas para garantir a satisfação e o alinhamento.

Habilidades e competências:

  • Conhecimento técnico: conhecimento técnico em processos produtivos tanto no início da produção quanto em final de linha. Automação de Equipamentos. Projetos de Digitalização; Melhoria Continua.
  • Habilidades de gestão: Planejamento, organização, liderança, comunicação e resolução de problemas.
  • Habilidades de comunicação: Comunicação clara e eficaz com a equipe, clientes e outras partes interessadas.

O que você pode esperar da gente?

Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:

  • Um programa de bem-estar, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbrio para a sua saúde física, mental e integral.
  • Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.

description:
The Opportunity:

Are you a creative designer with a keen eye for detail and a genuine interest in diving deeper into the gaming industry? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, team-focused environment where you can expand your design expertise and make a meaningful impact? If so, you could be a great fit for the Senior Graphic Designer, BR role we currently have available at Team Liquid.

As a Senior Graphic Designer, BR , you will play an important role in shaping the creative direction at Team Liquid. This position involves developing, managing, and executing high-impact visual assets across multiple platforms. A core aspect of this role is encouraging a feedback-focused environment, ensuring design consistency, and guiding junior designers. You will contribute to the evolution of design systems, while working closely with internal teams, including marketing and content.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Develop and execute high-impact visual concepts and campaigns across multiple platforms, from ideation to final delivery.
  • Ensure all designs align with Team Liquid's visual identity and brand guidelines. Create innovative assets in both static and motion that elevate brand storytelling and impact.

  • Help update design systems, including branding and style guides, to guide scalability.

  • Experiment with new tools, techniques, and trends to push creative boundaries.
  • Work with marketing, content, and creative teams to align design work with broader strategic goals.
  • Act as a design stakeholder in various campaigns, working closely with cross-functional teams.
  • Guide and mentor junior designers, offering constructive feedback and assisting with their growth. Conduct design reviews, offering direction and mentorship to junior designers.
  • Manage multiple design projects simultaneously, ensuring all timelines, deliverables, and quality standards are met.
  • Oversee the project lifecycle from conceptualization to execution, handling all aspects of design.
  • Identify areas for improvement in creative workflows, tools, and techniques to optimize design output and efficiency.
  • Introduce innovative approaches to creative processes to enhance continuous improvement.

What You’ll Need:

  • 5+ years of experience using Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Figma, and motion graphics.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Extensive knowledge of design concepts, typography, and photo retouching.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to handle multiple tasks.
  • Proven experience guiding junior designers through the creative process.
  • In-depth knowledge of current design trends, especially in esports, gaming, and the entertainment industry.
  • Fluent in English.

You'll Earn Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Interest in gaining deeper insights into esports and gaming culture, and alignment with Team Liquid’s brand.
  • Interest in Web3 and related technologies.
  • Experience with UI/UX design and 3D modeling.
  • Proficiency in Blender, Cinema4D, or similar tools for creating 3D assets.
  • Awareness of digital item design trends (e.g., in-game skins).

SOBRE O CLUBE DO VALOR:

O Clube do Valor foi fundado em 2015 com o objetivo de mudar, de verdade, a relação do brasileiro com o dinheiro. Com o passar do tempo, acertamos, erramos e aprendemos muito. Entendemos que, pra gente, o que importa mesmo são duas coisas: propósito (o que nos move) e cultura (o que somos e como agimos).

Nosso propósito é ambicioso: levar tranquilidade financeira para todos os brasileiros, para que cada um possa viver a vida dos seus sonhos. Para nos aproximarmos do nosso propósito, atuamos em duas frentes complementares: educação e gestão de investimentos. Já impactamos mais de 40 mil brasileiros com nossos conteúdos e ultrapassamos a marca de 3,5 bilhões de patrimônio sob aconselhamento.

Nosso conjunto de valores reflete o que é empreender e ser um sócio que gera VALOR para o CDV:

  • Experiência na área;

Como Desenvolvedor Laravel, suas atividades incluirão:

  • Implementação de regras de negócios;
  • Integrações com APIs;
  • Manutenção incremental e contínua do sistema, monitorando, identificando e corrigindo bugs;

  • Implementar e manter pipelines de CI/CD para garantir que as alterações de código sejam testadas e implantadas automaticamente em ambientes de produção;

Crescimento: temos um modelo de partnership que possibilita e estimula o crescimento de todos dentro da empresa, inclusive, premiando os melhores membros com a possibilidade de entrada na sociedade.

  • Criação de controles e KPIs: Desenvolver os principais controles e KPIs a serem monitorados pelo time de S&OP e principais áreas clientes para medir a acurácia do modelo de previsão de demanda em todas as etapas da cadeia;

  • Melhoria Contínua de Processos: Realizar melhorias constantes nos controles existentes, utilizando metodologias ágeis e de melhoria contínua, como Lean e Six Sigma;
  • Gestão de Governança: Criar e implementar rotinas de governança para acompanhar e validar os resultados do forecast, incluindo a comunicação regular com stakeholders internos e externos.

Requirements

  • Ability to read blueprints and technical documentation.

Education and Certifications:

  • Technical degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Data Center, Dell, HP, Cisco, ITIL, ISO) are highly desirable.

title: R&D Prod Dev Assoc Manager
description:
Overview

We Are PepsiCo . Join PepsiCo and Dare for Better! We are the perfect place for curious people, thinkers, and change agents. From leadership to front lines, we're excited about the future and working together to make the world a better place.

Being part of PepsiCo means being part of one of the largest food and beverage companies in the world, with our iconic brands consumed more than a billion times a day in more than 200 countries.

In Brazil since 1953, PepsiCo has well-known brands such as QUAKER, TODDY, TODDYNHO, ELMA CHIPS, RUFFLES, DORITOS, EQLIBRI, GATORADE, KERO COCO, H2OH!, PEPSI, among others.

A career at PepsiCo means working in a culture where all people are welcome. Here, you can dare to be you. No matter who you are, where you're from, or who you love, you can always influence the people around you and make a positive impact in the world. Know more: PepsiCoJobs Join PepsiCo, dare for better.

Responsibilities

The Opportunity

PepsiCo is a global food and beverage leader operating in more than 200 countries and territories with a product portfolio that includes 22 world-famous, billion-dollar brands. From Beverages to Snacks, we make hundreds of enjoyable foods and beverages that are loved throughout the world.

Guiding PepsiCo is our vision to be the global leader in convenient foods and beverages by Winning with Purpose. “Winning with Purpose” reflects our ambition to win sustainably in the marketplace and embed purpose into all aspects of the business.

You will be responsible for translating consumer needs into product requirements & technical parameters to launch delicious and nourishing products for CARICAM and South Cone. We are looking for a hands-on food product developer that has a passion for food science and is both, highly creative and technically oriented.

Our employees drive our culture. No two days are the same; we’re dynamic and full of passionate teams embracing new ideas through our collaborative spirit. At PepsiCo, what makes you unique, makes us better!

Its impact

  • Lead Innovation, TBS, Productivity and portfolio transformation agenda for grains category for CARICAM & South Cone and build the future of the platform to deliver growth and SOM through close working and partnership with R&D disciplines and business and SC teams to ensure a robust, safe and legal product design. Validate economic evaluations on ingredients, suppliers, and formulations.
  • Effectively manage multiple projects and project types, develop work streams, define resource needs, and drive alignment. Build and Track R&D budget.
  • Design and execute experiments. Analyze and interpret data to make sound technical recommendations on product and process issues.
  • Coordinate production at bench top, pilot plant, and manufacturing levels for shelf life, stability, sales samples, scale-up, and other needs. Guide Product formulations development that leverages expertise in food chemistry and food ingredient functionality.
  • The role involves managing priorities within direct team and across multiple commercial and business stakeholders leveraging expertise inside and outside the organization to deliver against commercial plans.
  • Support cross functional teams through Stage Gate process from Feasibility to Execution while ensuring a robust product & process design and support technical and business risk assessment/perspectives.
  • Project Management - Develop and execute complex projects utilizing technical project management tools and skills to ensure objectives are accomplished on time, to the agreed standards and within budget.
  • Clearly articulating and aligning technical development needs to influence the wider R&D organization to develop the correct future fit solutions.
  • Proactively challenging the suitability and performance of product designs to maintain a competitive advantage in terms of product acceptance, unique product design, cost of goods etc.
  • Heavy interaction and direct engagement with Contract Manufacturing & Ingredient Suppliers.
  • Actively participate in Marketing, Consumer Insights and Sensory and Consumer Experience Research to ensure data driven product design.
  • Proactively progress the Pep+ agenda from all aspects of our targets.
  • Support talent development by providing guidance and oversight to team members and maintain focus on people growth.
  • Represent R&D on multi-functional business teams comprised of individuals from a variety of disciplines, including Marketing, Purchasing, Engineering, and other groups.
  • Travel ~20%

Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For?

  • BSc in food engineering, material science, food/dairy science, chemistry or other related disciplines; >5 years’ experience with a Company Packaged Goods company with min 3 years in Research and Development.
  • Deep knowledge of ingredient function, formulation, mass balances -Process development – Knowledge of grain-based products; oatmeal, ready to eat cereal, pancake mix, baked products.
  • Project Management – experience managing technical projects for several complexities, setting up the agenda and building timelines to meeting deadlines.
  • Strong working knowledge of experimental design & product development protocols (from concept to execution), including formulation, stability testing, product/package interaction, and sensory and consumer testing methodology.
  • Detail oriented scientist who can manage and partner across R&D functions during product development life cycles that include new idea generation, prototype development, product optimization, production start-up and national launching of new product.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, think with empathy, and goal oriented.
  • Proven analytical skills to interpret complex data and translate into meaningful information e.g. interpreting consumer insights, experimental design and statistical inference and ability to disseminate to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Influence others through strong communication & interpersonal skills and outstanding teamwork.
  • Demonstrated ability to function effectively in a dynamic and fast-paced environment as well as manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Adapts to change, flexible to work in a high-performance and ever-changing environment. Demonstrates personal leadership to influence and positively motivate self and peers.
  • Strong organization, documentation, and Knowledge management skills.
  • Self-starter, self-motivating: able to balance competing priorities without losing momentum and manage uncertainty and complexity in fast evolving FMCG environments.
  • Strive for high standards, seek innovative solutions, drive continuous improvement of products and processes and demonstrates a high degree of intellectual curiosity.
  • Passion for creativity and innovation within a commercially driven environment.

If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.

title: Senior Solution Engineer Post-Sales
description:
About us

Taktile exists to create value for organizations through smarter and safer decisions at scale. Our goal is to become the world's leading software provider for automated decision-making in the financial services industry and, to date, our software has been used by our customers to power over 1’000’000 critical business decisions every day.

  • Taktile is based in New York City, London, and Berlin.

  • Taktile was founded by machine learning and data science veterans with extensive experience building and running production ML in financial services.

  • Our team consists of engineers, entrepreneurs, and researchers with a diverse set of backgrounds. Some of us attended top universities such as Harvard, Oxford, and Stanford and some of us have no degree at all.

  • Our team has accumulated extensive work experience at leading tech companies such as Google, Amazon, and Meta, startups, and the enterprise software sphere.

  • Our backers include Y Combinator, Index Ventures, and stellar angels such as the founders of Looker, GitHub, Mulesoft, Datadog, and UiPath.

We’re backed by some of the world’s leading investors and show great traction with scale-ups and large enterprises across the financial services industry. We are looking to build on this success by growing our team across all seniority levels from software engineers, web developers, marketing and sales experts, and entrepreneurial business analysts.

That's where you come in.

As a Senior Solution Engineer, you are core to our mission of transforming our customer's decisioning infrastructure to enable them to optimize and automate complex and mission critical business decisions. You will make sure our customers get onboarded on Taktile and get value from Taktile. You are a trusted advisor to our customers and help them achieve their strategic goals and realize value by using Taktile in their decisioning tech stack.

If you’re passionate about state-of-the-art tech products, have hands-on experience with Python, SQL, and REST APIs, and bring 2-5 years of customer-facing experience, you’ll thrive in this role. Plus, if you enjoy working in a supportive team environment that empowers you to grow, we think you’ll love this job!

What you’ll do as Senior Solution Engineer

  • You collaborate with partners and customers to design and build solutions in Taktile's Decisioning Platform.

  • You onboard and work with various of our customers' teams (domain experts, product, engineering, data science) to help them solve real-world problems. You understand people and technology, and are proficient and diligent in writing and testing Python code and committed to providing an excellent experience and fast time to value to Taktile’s customers.

  • You will work with product management to translate your knowledge of customer problems into product insights to shape Taktile's product roadmap.

  • You will create re-usable collateral, best practices & tools to help scale your knowledge and expertise across the solution engineering function.

About You

  • You know how to build strong customer relationships with stakeholders across different levels of seniority and including both technical stakeholders in an organization (e.g. Principal Engineers, Data Scientists) as well as business stakeholders (e.g. Risk Managers, Credit Analysts).

  • You are curious and customer-centric. You enjoy learning about our customers’ businesses and helping them solve challenges.

  • You excel at planning and managing project scope, expectations and timelines. You will need to manage multiple projects across customers that will be at different parts of their journey with Taktile.

  • You are humble and have a growth mindset, with a willingness to learn new skills and methodologies and bring best practices into our business.

  • You possess a solid understanding of REST APIs, including design, integration, and authentication. Additionally, you have strong knowledge of Python and SQL.

  • You are collaborative and work well with your peers in Marketing, Sales, Product, Engineering and the Customer Success team.

  • You are creative and proactive - you’re always looking for ways to stand out with customers.

  • You have excellent written and spoken English and Portuguese.

Ideal Qualifications (but not required)

  • You have 3-5 years of experience as a Solution Engineer, Implementation Specialist, Forward Deployed Engineer or an equivalent position within a B2B SaaS company or as Senior Consultant.

  • You have experience in applying and optimizing statistical and machine learning models to solve business problems.

  • You have experience with at least one of the major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • You have acquired domain expertise in the financial services industry (banking, insurance, capital markets, payments, etc.).

  • You are fluent in Spanish.

What we offer

  • Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here

  • Make an impact and meaningfully shape an early-stage company

  • Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo

  • Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe.

  • Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package

  • Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes.

  • Use the equipment of your choice including meaningful home office set-up.

Our Stance

  • We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply

  • We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
A Magnesium do Brasil é líder de negócios em pesquisa, beneficiamento e comercialização de magnesita. Com a visão de revelar o potencial do magnésio e tornar-se referência mundial no desenvolvimento, produção e comercialização de soluções de magnésio com qualidade, atuamos com portfólio de nutrição animal, massas refratárias e aplicações industriais. Pertencemos ao Groupe Roullier, que movido por uma energia coletiva, atua internacionalmente há mais de 60 anos em 8 áreas de atividade (Indústria Alimentar, Agrosupply, Fosfatos Alimentares, Magnésio, Nutrição Vegetal para o Público em Geral, Embalagem, Algologia e Energias Renováveis).

Todos os nossos funcionários incorporam nossos valores diariamente: Espírito de Equipe, Segurança, Desenvolvimento, Responsabilidade e Inovação. Comprometida com o desenvolvimento e a melhoria contínua, a Magnesium do Brasil está em constante evolução, colocando a experiência dos seus colaboradores no centro de todas as suas preocupações de gestão.

Nessa função, você terá a oportunidade de:

Desempenhar um papel crucial na proteção da saúde e segurança dos trabalhadores. Terá a chance de aplicar seus conhecimentos e habilidades para identificar e mitigar os riscos de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho seguro e saudável. Além disso, você poderá colaborar com diversas áreas da empresa, trabalhando em equipe para implementar políticas e procedimentos eficazes de segurança. Nessa posição, você fará parte do nosso time industrial em nossa fábrica em Jucás - CE, reportando-se à Coordenação de Segurança.

Você será responsável por:

  • Desenvolver programas de segurança específicos para ambientes industriais e de mineração, levando em consideração os riscos particulares associados a esses setores.
  • Conduzir auditorias de segurança para garantir a conformidade contínua com as regulamentações e os padrões de segurança.
  • Identificar e avaliar novas tecnologias e práticas de segurança que possam melhorar a eficácia dos programas de segurança no local de trabalho.
  • Investigar as ocorrências de segurança, analisando a causa raiz e definindo em conjunto com as áreas responsáveis, ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Apoiar na coordenação de equipes de resposta a emergências e a comunicação com as partes interessadas internas e externas.
  • Analisar dados relacionados à segurança e usar essas informações para tomar decisões informadas sobre melhorias nos programas de segurança.

Para ter sucesso nessa função, você deverá ter:

  • Nível Técnico em Segurança do trabalho.
  • Experiência na elaboração de Permissões de Trabalho e Análise Preliminar de Riscos.
  • Experiência em ministrar treinamentos regulatórios.
  • Experiência em análise de acidentes e incidentes, capacidade de identificar a causa raiz e atuar em conjunto com as áreas a preparação de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Experiência com análise de dados, estatísticas e que tenha afinidade com planilhas, apresentações e a criação de documentos como procedimentos, manuais, instruções de trabalho, dentre outros.
  • Experiência em lidar com equipamentos de segurança específicos da indústria, como EPIs (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual) e sistemas de monitoramento de segurança.

Um ambiente cheio de desafios, com oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento. Nossa fábrica possui um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso e alegre, resultado da nossa cultura.

Por que juntar-se a nós?

Juntar-se a nós é atrever-se a fazer a diferença, a tomar iniciativas, a saber transformar dificuldades em oportunidades e a colocar o seu talento ao serviço de um coletivo, de uma ambição partilhada: Crescer Juntos é caminhar juntos na mesma direção.

Fundada em 1905, a Magnesium do Brasil foi 100% adquirida pelo Grupo Roullier em 2021 – multinacional francesa com faturamento anual superior a 4 bilhões de Euros, mais de 10.400 colaboradores e presente em todos os continentes.

title: Student Mental Health Counselor – Wellness Center (2)
description:
Why the American University of Iraq – Baghdad?

Opening its doors in January of 2021, the new American University of Iraq – Baghdad (AUIB) began as a dream of influential individuals in Iraqi and the United States business, industry and government who want to see a world-class institution of higher learning established in the city, reminiscent of the days when Baghdad was an educational mecca and flourishing capital of the Muslim world. With a great library, palatial college buildings and student centers, state-of-the-art classrooms, laboratories, and athletic facilities, AUIB will be a beautiful campus attracting students, faculty, and staff from throughout the world. We invite you to join us in this exciting new venture.

This position will report directly to the Associate Director of Wellness Center.

Job Purpose

The Student Mental Health Counselor provides counseling services and programming designed to help students in the AUIB learning community improve their emotional wellbeing and develop the personal skills needed for successful university life. Services include crisis intervention, problem-solving, evidence-based psychotherapy and mental health counseling, psychological assessment, psychiatric referrals, and education and prevention programs. This newly created position will be a key player in ensuring that the AUIB Wellness Center is accessible for students in the upcoming spring 2024 semester and that students will have access to the mental health services that they need. The Wellness Center will initially have a primary focus on the offering of counseling and psychological services but will also offer student accessibility services as well as act as a campus safety center where students will be able to report their concerns, seek emergency help, or go for crisis intervention.

Areas of Accountabilities: Main Activities

  • Providing clinical services (intake, individual, group, and emergency/crisis counseling, and individual assessment), outreach and consultation services, training, light administrative duties.
  • Maintaining an active caseload of weekly counseling clients, for students.
  • Providing an ongoing program of personal, substance use, psychological, crisis intervention, and other types of counseling services to the students.
  • Accepting referrals from staff and faculty for students suspected of experiencing emotional, psychological, or personal difficulties.
  • Collaborating with faculty, staff, and/or University offices (HR and line managers) to support employee wellbeing.
  • Providing input for professional staff development programs for the Departments of Student Life and Student Services, and other University divisions or departments.
  • Assisting in developing and facilitating wellness programming for residence halls and First-Year Experience classes on relevant topics as needed. Topics may include substance abuse, sexuality, relationships, depression, and stress management.
  • Assisting in designing and coordinating programs for faculty and staff on identifying and dealing with students struggling with substance abuse, depression, hostility, family problems, etc.
  • Assisting in the coordination of care for students who are receiving mental health treatment off-campus.
  • Designing and conducting special interest counseling groups as needed focusing on mental health needs of the student population (e.g., substance use, relationship issues, sexual assault, academic pressures, etc.)
  • Preparing and maintaining treatment records, reports, and other required documentation while ensuring the confidentiality of all student information.
  • Providing programs and resources in support of AUIB-wide wellbeing initiatives.
  • Fulfilling other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

A: Educational Qualifications:

  • A Master’s degree in Clinical Mental Health Counseling or equivalent, full licensure by the relevant licensing authority for psychotherapy/counseling services.

B: Minimum Experience:

  • No less than 2-3 years of counseling experience.

C: Competencies (Knowledge, Skills & Abilities):

  • Additional licensure in clinical addictions counseling is preferred.
  • Evidence of the ability to work effectively and collegially in cross-functional teams.
  • Evidence of ability to participate in planning and participating in cross-functional collaboration regarding holistic student wellbeing.
  • Evidence of strategic thinking and leadership.
  • Ability to speak and work in both English and Arabic.

Application Requirements for Positions at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad

Required

To be considered for any role at the American University of Iraq—Baghdad (AUIB), applicants are required to submit the following documents:

  • Cover Letter: This should detail how your skills and experience align with the specific requirements of the position you are applying for.
  • Resume/Curriculum Vitae: Please provide an up-to-date resume or CV.
  • Identification: A valid national ID or passport is required for the application process.
  • Please note that applications missing any of these components will not be considered.

Shortlisted Candidates

If you are shortlisted for an interview, you will need to provide additional documentation:

  • Educational transcripts and certifications must be translated into English.
  • References: You must provide contact details for three references. These individuals should be those who have either worked with you or supervised your work.

We look forward to receiving your complete applications and appreciate your interest in joining our dynamic team at AUIB.

title: Engineering Manager, Payments
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

You're an original. So are we.

We're a company of people who like to forge our own path. We invented the blue jean in 1873, and we reinvented khaki pants in 1986. We pioneered labor and environmental guidelines in manufacturing. And we work to build sustainability into everything we do. Our brands stand for freedom and self-expression around the world.

Where we lead, others follow. For more than 160 years, we've used the strength of our brands to lead with our values and make an outsized impact on the world. We employ more than 15,000 people globally to support our great brands: Levi's, Dockers, Denizen, Signature by Levi Strauss & Co. and Beyond Yoga.

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead the Payments domain in our technology organization. This role is critical to ensuring secure, scalable, and efficient payment processing across our global e-commerce and retail ecosystem. You will be responsible for managing a high-performing engineering team that builds and operates payment APIs and services supporting credit cards, gift cards, Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL), fraud detection, reconciliation, and in-store payment integrations.

You will drive technical excellence, architecture, and execution in alignment with our domain-driven design and direct-to-consumer strategy. As an engineering leader, you will collaborate with product management, security, store teams, mobile app team, website teams, and external payment providers to deliver robust, compliant, and scalable payment solutions . You will lead a highly skilled team of software engineers in a “you build it, you run it” environment. Your primary responsibility will be to drive your team toward successful and efficient delivery of high-quality software, while fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. You’ll ensure the team is aligned with company goals, adheres to best engineering practices, and upholds robust DevOps principles, including designing, building, testing, deploying, and monitoring the applications and services they create.

About the Job

  • Lead and Mentor : Provide technical guidance, career development support, and mentorship to team members, helping them to grow in both technical and soft skills.

  • Team Leadership & Culture : Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and trust where engineers feel ownership of their work and are empowered to take initiative.

  • Strategic Planning : Work closely with Product Management, UX, and other stakeholders to define and deliver on a roadmap aligned with company objectives and customer needs.

  • Technical Execution : Ensure that technical designs, code, and testing meet high standards. Facilitate architectural and design discussions to guarantee scalable and resilient solutions.

  • Process Management : Improve software development processes, implementing best practices for CI/CD, code reviews, automated testing, and deployment to streamline development and deployment cycles.

  • Ownership of Operations : Champion a DevOps mindset, where the team not only builds but also runs and monitors their own applications in production, ensuring reliability, availability, and performance.

  • Problem Solving : Facilitate solutions to complex technical problems, proactively identifying bottlenecks, risks, and quality concerns, and implementing measures to address them.

  • Performance Monitoring : Track and report on team performance, KPIs, and quality metrics, ensuring a high level of transparency and focus on improvement areas. Prioritize talent development and help with hiring new talent and grow engineers that are already at Levi Strauss & Co.

  • Experience Working with Global Companies: Work with teams around the world and support your global-capable platform.

About You

  • 10+ years of experience in product and/or platform engineering role, with tangible accomplishments in ecommerce or similar customer-facing digital experiences and APIs.

  • Proven Experience : Minimum 7 years of engineering experience, including hands-on software development and at least 2 years in a management or technical leadership role.

  • Technical Skills : Proficiency in any of Java, Node.js, TypeScript, GoLang, with a deep understanding of modern software engineering and DevOps practices. Deep knowledge of RESTful APIs, event-driven architecture, and cloud-native services.

  • Strong Leadership : Track record of managing and motivating a team, fostering a productive, collaborative, and high-accountability environment.

  • Process Improvement : Demonstrated ability to identify process inefficiencies and implement improvements that accelerate development without compromising quality.

  • Problem Solving & Decision Making : Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make informed decisions and prioritize effectively.

  • Stakeholder Management : Experience working with cross-functional teams, especially Product and UX, to ensure cohesive product development and delivery.

  • Operational Excellence : Commitment to maintaining high standards for operational reliability, availability, and scalability, as well as familiarity with monitoring and alerting tools.

  • Hands-on experience with payment gateways, acquiring banks, fraud prevention, and reconciliation .

  • Understanding of PCI compliance, security best practices, and fraud prevention strategies.

  • Familiarity with payment orchestration, tokenization, chargebacks, and settlement processes.

LOCATION : Mexico, D.F., Mexico

FULL TIME/PART TIME : Full time

Você conhece a LDC? A LDC é uma das principais comercializadoras e processadoras globais de produtos agrícolas, com um portfólio diversificado que abrange toda a cadeia de valor, da originação à distribuição. Com atividades no centro da produção agrícola e de alimentos, guiados por nossos fortes valores, por um legado rico e uma visão clara, estamos comprometidos em trabalhar por um futuro seguro e sustentável. Somos guiados por valores que norteiam todos os públicos em nosso trabalho. A ética e integridade fazem parte de todas as relações de negócio, assim como a humildade, comprometimento e diversidade.

Job Description

O Gerente de Entrega de Serviços responsável pelo suporte remoto de TI é responsável por garantir a entrega eficiente e eficaz dos serviços de TI para atender às necessidades da organização. Essa função envolve gerenciar uma equipe de profissionais de suporte de help desk, coordenar processos de entrega de serviços e manter altos níveis de satisfação do cliente.

  1. Supervisionar as operações do suporte remoto de TI: gerenciar as operações diárias do suporte remoto, garantindo a resolução oportuna e eficaz de problemas de TI.
  2. Monitoramento de desempenho: acompanhar o desempenho do suporte por meio de indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) como tempo de resposta, tempo de resolução e satisfação do cliente.
  3. Gestão de incidentes e solicitações: garantir que todos os incidentes e solicitações de serviço sejam registrados, priorizados e resolvidos de acordo com os acordos de nível de serviço (SLAs).
  4. Melhoria contínua: identificar áreas de melhoria nos processos do suporte e implementar mudanças para aprimorar a eficiência e a qualidade do serviço.
  5. Gestão de equipe: liderar, orientar e desenvolver uma equipe de profissionais de suporte remoto de TI.
  6. Treinamento e desenvolvimento: oferecer oportunidades de treinamento e aprimoramento de habilidades para a equipe.
  7. Engajamento de stakeholders: construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders internos e externos, garantindo que suas necessidades de TI sejam atendidas.
  8. Reuniões de revisão de serviço: conduzir reuniões regulares de revisão de serviço com stakeholders-chave para discutir o desempenho do serviço e áreas de melhoria.
  9. Feedback do cliente: coletar e analisar o feedback do cliente para identificar tendências e fazer melhorias baseadas em dados.
  10. Estratégia de serviço: desenvolver e implementar estratégias de entrega de serviço alinhadas aos objetivos da organização e às melhores práticas ITIL.
  11. Gestão de orçamento: administrar o orçamento para operações do suporte remoto e suporte onsite, garantindo uma entrega de serviço econômica.
  12. Implementação de tecnologias: avaliar e implementar novas tecnologias e ferramentas para melhorar a entrega de serviços e capacidades de suporte.
  13. Gestão de riscos: identificar e mitigar riscos associados à entrega de serviços, garantindo continuidade de negócios e conformidade com regulamentos.

Experiência

  • Experiência com produtos SaaS (ServiceNow, Remedy, JIRA, etc.).
  • Sólido conhecimento de operações de entrega de serviços.
  • Conhecimentos: plataforma Windows, computadores pessoais baseados em Intel, tipos e funções de servidores, telefones IP, dispositivos móveis.
  • Idiomas: inglês fluente.

The mission of California Lutheran University is to educate leaders for a global society who are strong in character and judgment, confident in their identity and vocation, and committed to service and justice. As a federally recognized Hispanic-Serving Institution, Cal Lutheran is looking for candidates with a dedication to and success in working in diverse communities. The university is committed to an inclusive learning and work environment that values individual differences and respects each person’s dignity.
